main_text.p: & sacris congressibus, in quibus Deus pu-re colitur, subducunt, neue uel iacturam fortunarum suarum faciant, uel quæstus faciendi arisam[?] negligant.

Quod autem ebrijs interdum euenire uidemus, ut eorum obliuiscatur, quæ nemini sano ignota sunt: id etiam Sanctis, si quandō τὸ τῆς σαρκὸς φρόνημα[?] secuti, suis desiderijs indulgent, & ubi non erat metuendum metuunt, accidit, ut ea non veniant in mentem, quæ ipsos alioquin non fugiunt. Vt Ionæ fugienti è conspectu Iehouæ, in illo paroxysmo non venit in mentem illud Dauidis: Quò ibo à Spiritu tuo, & quò fugiam à facie tua? Si ascendero in cœlum, ibi es: & si stratum fecero in inferno, ecce tu ades. Psal. 139. 6. 7. 8. 9.
main_text.head: THESIS SECVNDA, DE RECV-fatione officij diuinitùs demandati.
main_text.p: Lectio ii.17. Octob.1. Pessimè agunt, qui sanctam uocatio-nem serio detrectant. Aduersantur enim consilio & uoluntati diuinæ, de qua dicitur 1. Cor. 7. 17. Vt unicuiq; (donum) partitus est Deus, ut unumquemque uocauit Dominus, ita incedat: & ita in Ecclesijs omnibus constituo.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "arisam" at the end of the second line of the running text is not clear and may be a misprint; the Greek phrase after "quandō" (Rom. 8:6) is copied from a small, worn print and should be checked; "RECV-" at the heading line end is uncertain, and the completed word is probably "recusatione" but the printed split is not fully legible. The numbers "1." and "2." before the paragraphs are small and may be read as other figures. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page and continues on the next page.
